authority.source: Owner, 2026-11-09, issue #2299: "one Interaction tab (rename Messages) holding everything audience", decisions D1-D8 agreed one at a time in the planning session of 2026-11-09. Owner: "When you are done with the plan, give me a prompt, and I'll get a second opinion before we start building." Draft until the owner agrees the plan after that review; no implementation is authorized. Same day, owner supplied an independent second opinion and asked: "Revise the draft Interaction plan ... using the independent review below. Keep owner decisions D1-D8. Planning only ... Keep the plan's authority status draft." Revised accordingly. Owner on O1: "one question has one result. If you need to have many results for a question, you can just make a new question." Owner on Clear results: "Yes, let's add the Clear Results button. It can be very useful when testing." The plan stays draft until the owner agrees it.
